scope.description: Local correlation of an actually released remote read request to its emitted ReadIndexResp in a stable leader term and membership.
assumptions: Crash-fault operation with unmodified messages produced by configured peers.
Distinct nonzero SystemCtx values identify the pending requests; source identity and term are preserved through delivery.
excluded: Numeric completion deadlines or unconditional read availability
Wrong read values or linearizability violations
Restart and concurrent membership change during the confirmation

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target code changes. Captured TestLogDB provides in-memory storage for a no-crash history.
Network and application scheduling are implemented by the driver; responses are produced only by Peer.Handle.
Read-only internal sampling verifies pending records, membership, term and completed setup.

plan_uncertainties: The measured boundary is the leader outgoing message, with follower ReadyToRead as diagnostics; client completion and read values are not measured.
Source-backed bootstrap acceptance replaces application callbacks only for initialized AddNode entries; no membership changes overlap the read requests.
grounding_unresolved: This driver does not execute NodeHost client batching or timeout callbacks; their exact-context consumer behavior is source-grounded only.
